name: Watamu Beach Club & Villas
summary: Villas and a private beach club on Mayungu Bay, beside the Watamu Marine National Park.
story: At low tide, white sandbanks rise from the sea and the reef sits a short paddle from the beach. Fishermen launch their dhows from Mayungu at dawn. The villas open onto verandas around a central pool, and the beach club waits at the end of a 150-metre path through the gardens. Inland, the Arabuko Sokoke Forest and the ruins of Gedi keep their own quiet.
leads: Local guides from the beach club, the kitchen team and the wellness therapists
hero_alt: Rippled white sand and shallow turquoise water at low tide on Mayungu Bay

expect.label: Setting
expect.value: Mayungu Bay, between Malindi and Watamu, beside the Watamu Marine National Park in Kenya.

expect.label: The bay
expect.value: Shallow, clear water over white sand, sandbanks at low tide and the reef close to shore.

expect.label: Stay
expect.value: Villas from one to four bedrooms, each with a kitchen, a lounge and a private veranda.

expect.label: At the table
expect.value: Two restaurants, the main pavilion and a beach restaurant on the sand: Italian roots, Indian Ocean fish and coastal Swahili spice.

expect.label: Families
expect.value: Children welcome. All-inclusive, half-board and self-catering stays.

expect.label: Getting there
expect.value: Transfers from Malindi Airport on request.
